services.title: 360° Digital Marketing
services.short: Strategy, production and performance under one roof.
services.description: We manage your brand's digital presence end to end. From marketing planning to creative production, from media buying to data-driven optimization — one team, one account plan.
services.long_description: Most brands switch agencies as they grow — they realize they need an extra layer while scaling. We close that gap from the start. From social media to SEO, from your website to ad management, every channel is part of a single strategy.
services.hero: Grow with a single partner, not multiple agencies. 360° marketing unites your brand's entire digital presence under one vision; it breaks down silos and multiplies your speed.
services.approach: Marketing is a holistic game: an improvement made in one channel affects the customer returning from another. We model your brand as a single 'nervous system'. The ad team, the SEO team and the social media team all work from the same strategy document, the same KPI set and the same creative library.
bullets: Monthly performance report and live dashboard
360° coordination with a single account manager
ideal_for: Those who feel lost across multiple channels
Teams tired of juggling multiple agencies

services.title: Ad Management
services.short: Performance-focused media buying on Google, Meta and TikTok.
services.description: We build ad campaigns that deliver maximum return on your budget, continuously tested and optimized. We turn every click into a purchase and every impression into brand value.
services.long_description: Advertising sits at the intersection of science and art. Finding the right audience is data; delivering the right message to them is creativity.
services.hero: Ad management that doggedly brings your budget back rather than just spending it. Data-driven, creative-powered performance campaigns on Google, Meta and TikTok.
services.approach: A great ad account is where three things meet: the right audience, the right creative, the right measurement. If we don't see a meaningful pattern within 14 days, we don't hesitate to change the strategy.
bullets: Conversion tracking, GA4 and attribution setup

services.title: SEO
services.short: Sustainable traffic through technical SEO, content and link building.
services.description: Long-term organic growth that reduces your dependence on ads. From site architecture to Core Web Vitals, from topic clusters to international SEO, we see the big picture.
services.long_description: There's no shortcut in SEO, but there are plenty of wrong paths. We work with clear goals.
services.hero: Traffic that keeps coming even when you turn off the ads. Sustainable organic growth through technical SEO, content architecture built around user intent and genuine authority links.
services.approach: SEO is a marathon, not a sprint; but well-structured marathons advance at a predictable pace. We produce content that follows EEAT principles, is resilient against AI, and builds real authority.

services.title: Mobile App Development
services.short: High-performance apps for iOS and Android.
services.description: From idea to launch; we build scalable, store-ready mobile apps with React Native and native technologies. From design to analytics setup, all in one place.
services.hero: Scalable mobile apps that get store approval and that users love. We turn your idea into a live product within 8-16 weeks.
services.approach: 'Building' a mobile app is easy; making it stick in the store is hard. We bake App Store approval processes, push notification strategy, onboarding optimization and ASO into the architecture from day one.
bullets: App Store and Google Play release management
ideal_for: Digital products in the service sector

services.title: SaaS Product Development
services.short: We turn your idea into a scalable product.
services.description: From MVP to enterprise architecture, from subscription infrastructure to AI integrations, we build modern SaaS products. Expertise in Next.js, Node, Postgres and cloud-based infrastructure.
services.hero: Not just code, but a scalable business model. Modern SaaS products from MVP to enterprise, from subscription infrastructure to AI integrations.
services.approach: For SaaS startups, 'how fast do you write code' is the wrong question. The right question is: 'how fast can we find product-market fit?'. Stripe integration from day one, multi-tenant architecture, OpenAI/Anthropic integrations and growth-ready infrastructure are all part of the standard package.
bullets: Auth, role management and admin panel
deliverables: Handover package for the product team
ideal_for: Existing brands launching a SaaS product

services.title: Social Media Management
services.short: A consistent brand voice, measurable community growth.
services.description: We don't just produce content; we build communities. We keep your brand alive in the digital world through trend tracking, format testing and active dialogue with your customers.
services.hero: Not follower count, but depth of engagement. Trend-aware social media management with a consistent brand voice.
services.approach: Social media is not a broadcast but a dialogue channel. The team producing the content and the team talking to the community are the same people — because the best content is born from the questions followers ask.
bullets: Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts production

services.title: Web Design & Development
services.description: Not just aesthetics; corporate websites and landing pages designed for page speed, SEO and conversion rate.
services.hero: Page speed 95+, high conversion rate, flawless on mobile. We rebuild your brand's digital office with Next.js.
services.approach: A website is a company's digital office. We think of websites not as a 'design' problem but as a 'salesperson': every section must do a job of persuasion, every CTA must lead to an action.
bullets: A/B testing infrastructure and CRO optimization
ideal_for: Those needing a landing page library

services.title: Content & Brand Strategy
services.short: A memorable brand identity and a consistent story.
services.description: From logo to tone-of-voice guide, from launch campaign to annual content vision, we design your brand's digital DNA.
services.hero: We design what your customers feel when they recognize you. Logo, tone, message, campaign — all the visual and verbal identity that makes a brand memorable.
services.approach: A brand is everything the customer remembers before even hearing your brand name. We document this piece by piece and turn it into a scalable brand book.

service_faqs.question: What is the transition process from my current agency like?
service_faqs.answer: First, a 2-3 week parallel handover process. We communicate with your current agency and seamlessly take over the accounts, data and ongoing campaigns. Zero disruption.

service_faqs.question: Can I still get this service if I have an in-house marketing team?
service_faqs.answer: Of course. Most of our clients prefer the model where we work as an extension of their in-house marketing team.

service_faqs.question: How many people will work on my account?
service_faqs.answer: Typically 1 account manager + 3-5 specialists (ads, SEO, creative, social media, etc.) actively work with your team.

service_faqs.question: Is logo design included?
service_faqs.answer: Yes. The logo and the entire color palette are included. Refreshing an existing logo is also possible.

service_faqs.question: What does the brand book look like?
service_faqs.answer: Between 70-120 pages, a guide that is both written and visual.

service_faqs.question: How long does repositioning take?
service_faqs.answer: Typically 8-12 weeks. The research phase can take longer; creation and implementation are faster.

service_faqs.question: React Native or native?
service_faqs.answer: In most cases React Native; development time is halved, and a single codebase ships to both platforms.

service_faqs.question: Will the store reject it?
service_faqs.answer: Every app we've managed so far has been approved. If a rejection comes, the fixes until approval are covered by the retainer.

service_faqs.question: What about ongoing maintenance afterwards?
service_faqs.answer: 30 days of post-launch support is included. After that, a monthly maintenance/feature retainer is defined.

service_faqs.question: How will you take over my existing ad accounts?
service_faqs.answer: We gain account access via Google and Meta Business Manager. Account ownership remains with you.

service_faqs.question: Can I expect results in the first month?
service_faqs.answer: The first 30 days are a learning period. Meaningful performance improvement typically begins between 45-90 days.

service_faqs.question: Is creative production included?
service_faqs.answer: Yes. A set number of static images and video creatives per month is included in the retainer.

service_faqs.question: How is the ad budget managed?
service_faqs.answer: The ad budget is spent directly from your own ad accounts — we only manage it. Full transparency.

service_faqs.question: Who owns the source code?
service_faqs.answer: Entirely you. We work through your GitHub organization, and intellectual property is yours from day one.

service_faqs.question: Can it be handed over to our own developer team?
service_faqs.answer: Yes, this is the standard process. The handover package includes documentation, onboarding and 4 weeks of parallel support.

service_faqs.question: How are AI features integrated?
service_faqs.answer: We embed LLMs into product flows, primarily the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs.

service_faqs.question: When will I see the first results?
service_faqs.answer: The impact of technical improvements starts to appear in Search Console within 4-8 weeks. Content rankings settle within 3-6 months, and authority keywords within 6-12 months.

service_faqs.question: Do you write AI content?
service_faqs.answer: Not entirely. We leverage AI, but every published piece is rewritten and verified by a human.

service_faqs.question: Isn't link building risky?
service_faqs.answer: We stay away from black-hat techniques. We only do digital PR, guest authorship and content amplification.

service_faqs.question: Do you optimize my existing content?
service_faqs.answer: Yes, this process called content refresh is one of the fastest ways to gain wins.

service_faqs.question: Who does the filming?
service_faqs.answer: Depending on the nature of the content: shooting in our own studio, collaborating with UGC creators, or editing raw content filmed on the brand's side.

service_faqs.question: Which platforms do you work on?
service_faqs.answer: Priority: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts. LinkedIn, X and Threads are added as needed.

service_faqs.question: What are the community management hours?
service_faqs.answer: Active management weekdays 09:00-19:00. We have a 24/7 on-call system for emergencies.

service_faqs.question: Can you redesign my existing site?
service_faqs.answer: Yes. We redesign while preserving the existing site's SEO value — including 301 redirects and content migration.

service_faqs.question: Which CMS do you recommend?
service_faqs.answer: If content volume is high, Sanity; for a more classic admin panel, Strapi.

service_faqs.question: Where is the hosting?
service_faqs.answer: We recommend Vercel or Cloudflare — zero config, zero downtime, global edge network.

faqs.question: How long does a reply take?
faqs.answer: We respond to form submissions received on weekdays within an average of 6-12 hours, and to submissions received on weekends by Monday noon.

faqs.question: What should I prepare for the meeting?
faqs.answer: Your current goals, the performance data of the last 3 months if any, viewing-only access to your web/app/social media analytics, and your reference brands if possible. Even if none of these are ready, the meeting will still be productive.

faqs.question: Am I required to share my budget?
faqs.answer: No, but it helps. If the budget range is unclear, we clarify it together during the meeting. We talk with you regardless of your budget model.

faqs.question: Can I work with you from abroad?
faqs.answer: Of course. 30% of our clients are based abroad (UK, US, AE). We can hold all our meetings in Turkish or English.

faqs.question: Which sectors do you work in?
faqs.answer: We work across a wide range, primarily e-commerce, SaaS, health, fintech, education and B2B services.

faqs.question: What is the minimum contract duration?
faqs.answer: For services requiring continuity such as ad management and SEO, we recommend a minimum of 3 months of engagement.

faqs.question: How do you handle reporting?
faqs.answer: We set up a live Looker Studio dashboard for each of our clients.

faqs.question: Who produces the creatives?
faqs.answer: We have in-house art directors, motion designers and copywriters for ad visuals, video edits and social media content.

faqs.question: How do you integrate with my existing team?
faqs.answer: We work like an extension of your in-house marketing or technology team.

faqs.question: What is your pricing model?
faqs.answer: For ad management, a percentage of your budget + a fixed management fee; for SEO and content, we work with monthly retainer models.

faqs.question: Can I get services individually, or is a package mandatory?
faqs.answer: No, there's no package requirement. You can start with a single service and open up other areas as needed. Most of our clients start with ad management or SEO; within 6 months they expand to 2-3 services.

faqs.question: What should the minimum ad budget be?
faqs.answer: It's hard to truly test below ₺50,000/month on Meta Ads and ₺75,000 on Google Ads. For budgets below these figures, we recommend starting with organic channels first (SEO + social media).

faqs.question: Is creative production included or an extra charge?
faqs.answer: In our retainer model, a set number of creatives per month is included (ad visual, video, post). Additional creative needs are resolved with clear pricing — no surprise invoices.

faqs.question: What happens if I'm not satisfied?
faqs.answer: Guaranteed measurable improvement in the first 90 days. If it doesn't happen, the contract ends and we don't charge for the last month. We put this in the contract.

page_sections.description: True EDigital Marketing is positioned at the intersection of performance marketing and technology development. Since 2019, we have offered digital growth partnership to e-commerce, SaaS and service brands.

page_sections.title: The story of our founder Emre Tagay

items.text: Emre Tagay entered the digital marketing world in 2015 as the founder of an e-commerce brand. To grow his own brand, he had to learn Google Ads, Meta Ads and SEO — and he realized that many brands in Turkey were struggling with the same problem: not being able to find the right agency.

Most agencies are full of large clients or only specialize in a single area. Finding a partner who thinks about strategy, produces creative and develops technology all at once was rare. After providing freelance consulting to 12+ brands between 2017-2019, he founded True EDigital Marketing with the question "why don't I turn this into a team effort".

When founding True EDigital Marketing in 2019, his goal was clear: an agency that treats the client's business like a partner, never forgets the human behind the numbers, and masters both the creative and technical sides. Today our Istanbul-based team consists of 14 people; we serve a broad portfolio from e-commerce to fintech, from health tourism to SaaS startups.

I still personally lead the first strategy meeting as founder whenever a new project comes on board. Because trust is built only this way. Even as a fast-growing agency, we will preserve this principle.

page_sections.title: Brands we've grown together
page_sections.description: Every project set off with a different goal; but the one thing they all share is measurable results. Below are examples of work we have permission to share.

page_sections.title: Lumen Cosmetics — ROAS 2.1x → 4.8x
page_sections.description: A worn-out ad account, a stale creative approach and a fragmented analytics infrastructure. Through a three-month restructuring, we show how the numbers multiplied.

quote.name: Selin Aksoy
quote.text: In the 6 months we worked with True EDigital Marketing, our ROAS rose from 2.1 to 4.8. The most impressive thing wasn't the numbers but the team dynamic — they own our brand as much as we do.

steps.desc: We deeply analyzed the existing accounts, data and customer behavior. We identified 3 hypotheses: wrong targeting, creative fatigue and landing page leakage.
steps.title: Audit & Strategy (Week 1-2)

steps.desc: We restructured the account around ASC + Advantage+. A/B tests began with 18 new creative concepts and 4 different landing pages.
steps.title: Restructuring (Week 3-6)

steps.desc: We scaled the winning creatives to different segments, merged the Meta + Google attribution model and strengthened the email flows.
steps.title: Scale (Week 7-12)

steps.desc: ROAS 4.8x, customer count 6.4K, average basket value up 22%. The gains are maintained with a monthly iteration rhythm.
steps.title: Sustainable growth (Week 13+)
